dataTypes.note: Includes the parent or guardian email a 13–17 user enters for approval: sent once, the address itself is not stored, only a one-way digest for rate limiting (Motion publishing profile P6).
IP-derived country/region/city added by the Supabase Edge to request logs; no GPS or precise-location permission.

Password hash (Supabase Auth), declared birth month/year and country (motion_age_declarations; no day is asked), parental-consent state and the account-deletion receipt digest. The App Store age range shared through Declared Age Range on iOS 26+ is used on the device to check the declaration.

dataTypes.source: Core R3 f43d71a (unchanged in R4 0d29d1b): motion_entitlements stores the server-verified subscription per account (store, product_id, original_transaction_id, state, expires_at, verified_at) so access can be restored; motion_trial_ledger keeps one Motion+ trial start (app_id, started_at) per account; store server notifications (App Store Server Notifications v2 / Play RTDN) refresh the same row. Both tables are deleted with the account. Payment card data never reaches the app or Motion servers.
